author: reek
body: A rolling twenty-sided die, ray-traced from Codex [Device] AST. The same icosahedron mesh as the glTF demo (20 triangles in a storage buffer), but each face is numbered: when a pixel hits a triangle the kernel recovers the hit's barycentric coordinates, maps them into the face's equilateral frame, and stamps the face number (1..20) with a 3x5 bitmap-font glyph in white on a deep crimson die. The triangle fold reads vertices through the storage-pointer helper parameter and runs Moller-Trumbore, exactly like the glTF demo.
